provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: projection monotonicity applied twice to the certified chi(T3^3) >= 6

notes: Puts the cell at 6 <= chi <= 18. The certificate re-runs the m=3 rank-6 exclusion (Galois descent cutting the search to 45 candidate lines, then exhaustion with every candidate rejected in exact arithmetic over Q(w9)) and applies projection monotonicity: chi(psi (x) phi) >= chi(psi) whenever phi has a nonzero computational amplitude. The sector decomposition behind the upper bound gives no better lower bound, since max_j chi(c_j) <= chi(T3^5) and the sectors are only known to have rank between 5 and 6. Beating the published exponent 1/2 at m=5 needs rank 15, which is rank 5 in every sector.
